description: Get a paginated list of users that voted for a specific answer on a poll message. Use it after fetching a poll message with discord_get_message to see who selected each answer. Page subsequent voters with after=next_after. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

after.description: User snowflake ID cursor to fetch voters after (use next_after)

answer_id.description: ID of the poll answer to list voters for (answer_id is poll.answers[].answer_id on the message from discord_get_message)

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message

limit.description: Max number of voters to return (1-100; default is 25)

name: discord_list_poll_answer_voters

anyOf.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
